cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.description: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: This is an extremely rare Meowth card. Maybe good fortune will come to you if you hold this card!

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.description: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: It lives in water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.description: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

cards.name: Carracosta
cards.description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.description: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.description: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.description: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.description: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.description: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.description: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.description: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.description: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.description: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.description: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.description: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.description: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.description: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.description: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.description: It it thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.description: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

cards.name: Archen
cards.description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.description: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a volt of electricity.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.description: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attack. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.description: It wield the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arms attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: When they feel threatened, they spit acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves against Heatmor.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.description: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

cards.name: Audino
cards.description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.description: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.description: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.description: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
